Meta.title: To Buy List: shopping lists with price, link and total
Meta.description: Build shopping lists with the name, store, price and link of each item, see the total right away and share the list with whoever is buying with you. Works in the browser, on your phone and on your computer.
Meta.landingOgAlt: To Buy List: write down what you want to buy and see how much you'll spend

hero.title: Write down what you want to buy. See how much you'll spend.
hero.subtitle: Try it now, no sign-up ↓

featuresSection.title: What it does
featuresSection.intro: No spreadsheets. A list that knows how to add up, plus a few other useful things.

features.title: Paste the link, it tries to fill in the rest
features.text: Paste the product address and the app tries to pull the name, store, price and photo. Some stores don't let it read the page, and then you type it in. Either way, you can check everything before saving.

features.title: The math does itself
features.text: Each item has a price and a quantity, and the list total sits at the top. You know how bad the damage is before you leave the house.

features.title: Send it to whoever is buying with you
features.text: The app gives you a link to the list. You decide whether the other person can only look or can also change the items. Whoever receives it signs in with their own account and can save the list.

features.title: The most urgent stays on top
features.text: Drag the items into the order you plan to buy them.

features.title: A list that repeats? We duplicate it
features.text: Monthly groceries, school supplies, a new home: duplicate a list and adjust only what changed instead of starting over.

steps.title: Give the list a name
steps.text: “New house”, “December gifts”, “July trip”. Whatever makes sense to you.

steps.title: Start adding things
steps.text: Paste the product link or type the name, store, price and quantity. You can do it little by little, over several days.

steps.title: Check the total and share
steps.text: See how much it came to, fix the order and, if you want, send the link to whoever is helping.

useCases: that wish list that now lives in your phone's notes app

faqs.question: What is To Buy List?
faqs.answer: It's a web app for building shopping lists. Each item keeps a name, store, price, quantity, link and image, and the list shows the total automatically.

faqs.question: Do I need to install anything?
faqs.answer: No. It works right in the browser, on your phone or your computer. Just click Sign in and use your account, including your Google one.

faqs.question: How does filling in from a link work?
faqs.answer: When you paste a product link, the app tries to read the store's page and fill in the name, store, price and image. Not every store allows that. When it doesn't work, you fill it in by hand and check the values before saving.

faqs.question: How do I share a list with someone else?
faqs.answer: Open the list, click the link button and choose whether the other person can change the items. The app copies the address for you to send. Whoever receives it signs in with their own account, sees the list and can save it.

faqs.question: Can I change the order of the items?
faqs.answer: Yes. Just drag the items to put the most important or most urgent ones first.

faqs.question: Can I copy a list I already used?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the Duplicate option in the list menu to make a copy and adjust what changed.
